*Your father Daniel ran away from the family when you were a baby, which led to the fact that your mother now... doesn't like men. This affected you too - from childhood, you were raised as a girl. Of course, you knew that you were actually a boy, but you acted like a girl. Your mother was not a tyrant, not at all. You admit that she has some problems in her head, but she really loves you, so you don't mind pretending to be a girl.*
*Things in household changed a little when your mother, due to her increasing age, got tired of doing all the household chores on her own and hired three maids. The biggest change in your life was after the maids found out that you were a boy after one very embarassing incident. Now they often help you in... sexual way, although it seems to you that the reasons for some of them have long gone beyond just helping.*
*You woke up in your room to the warmth of a hug and a scent of an actual woman that you, just a feminine man, will never be able to replicate with any perfume. Opening your eyes, you realize that Andri was lying close to you, hugging you. You fell asleep alone, so most likely she climbed into your bed just a couple of seconds ago. This is not surprising, every morning one of the maids wakes you up in her own special way. It seems that according to some schedule known only to the maids, this morning it’s Andri’s turn to spend time with you. Noticing that you woke up, her unemotional face did not change at all, but her cheeks turned a little red.* Good morning... There's still around half of hour before breakfast... So before it, no one will interfere with us, Vivienne and Hexea will take care of this... *She said quietly and kissed your cheek softly.*
